name: Yellow Discovers Giant Whoopee Cushion
title: Whoopie Cushion Chaos!

settings.characterDesign:
A soft cinematic character scene in a stylized semi-3D cartoon animation style, blending cute illustration aesthetics with subtle realism.
Scene:
a quiet nighttime alley illuminated by a single warm streetlight, with a small character standing alone in the light, interacting with small animals (dog, rabbit, cats), creating an emotional and heartwarming moment
Character fidelity (CRITICAL):
chibi-style character with a rounded, simplified body
large head, small body proportions
no realistic anatomy
smooth, soft silhouette
minimal facial features (simple glowing eyes or soft expressions)
oversized glossy helmet visor (black or very dark with soft reflections)
soft suit design (puffy, rounded, cozy look)
small backpack or simple accessory allowed
no mechanical complexity, no hard-surface sci-fi armor
character must feel cute, vulnerable, and emotional
Composition:
cinematic framing with strong focus on character
medium shot or close-up shot
character placed under a spotlight (streetlight)
strong contrast between light (warm) and darkness (cool background)
use negative space to emphasize loneliness
animals positioned naturally around the character (foreground interaction)
camera slightly low or eye-level for emotional connection
soft depth with background fading into darkness
Characters:
main character: cute astronaut-style figure (yellow suit preferred)
animals: small, stylized, soft (dog, rabbit, cats)
animals must feel gentle, calm, and emotionally connected
no aggressive motion, everything feels quiet and still
poses are simple and readable (sitting, offering food, watching)
Environment design:
simple alley environment
wooden fences or plain walls on both sides
soft distant buildings with warm window lights
minimal props: trash can, scattered leaves, small objects on ground
environment should feel empty and quiet
avoid clutter, focus on mood
Lighting (VERY IMPORTANT):
strong single warm light source (streetlamp)
circular spotlight on the ground
soft glow and light falloff
background remains cool, dark blue tones
subtle rim light around character
gentle bloom effect on light
no harsh shadows, only soft gradients
Line style:
clean, smooth outlines
slightly softer than vector (not too sharp)
no sketchiness
no broken lines
consistent thickness but not overly rigid
edges feel polished and animation-ready
Color:
warm vs cool contrast (yellow/orange light vs blue night)
soft, slightly desaturated palette
smooth gradients (allowed in lighting only)
no harsh color jumps
gentle color transitions
no texture, no grain
Surface quality:
soft, matte surfaces
slight subsurface glow feeling on characters
no realistic material rendering
no rough textures
clean digital finish
Mood / Emotion (VERY IMPORTANT):
lonely but warm
emotional, quiet storytelling
feeling of kindness and small connection
subtle sadness mixed with comfort
cinematic storytelling moment (like a short film frame)
Depth:
foreground: character + animals
midground: lit ground area
background: dark alley fading into distance
use blur and light falloff for depth (not heavy DOF)
Style:
Pixar-inspired softness + 2D illustration charm
stylized semi-3D look
animated short film quality
soft cinematic rendering
emotionally driven visual storytelling
Avoid:
realistic human anatomy
hard sci-fi mechanical suits
sharp or aggressive lighting
noisy textures or grain
overly detailed backgrounds
exaggerated cartoon outlines
messy composition
high contrast horror tones
settings.idea: Yellow discovers a giant whoopee cushion under their desk at work.
settings.style: 2d flash animation style, simple outline art style, Among Us game style

storyboard:
Title: Whoopie Cushion Chaos!

Total duration: 15 seconds

Genre: Comedy

Mood: Joy



Key object / product hook:

One visible object must drive the story events and appear repeatedly as the main prop, making it suitable for a future product or affiliate link.



Character prompt format:

Main character: [age or role], [face and hair details], [clothing], [distinctive prop], [emotion], [body language], consistent appearance across every scene.

Character prompt for this story: Among Us game character Yellow. Design: A professional 2D character turnaround sheet of a yellow crewmate (Among Us style), including front, back, left profile, and right profile views.

Body proportions:
- height about 2.5x the width
- rounded top, flat bottom feet
- legs separated with a small gap
- no visible arms

Backpack:
- rectangular with rounded corners
- centered on upper back
- same color as body with slightly darker shading

Visor:
- large horizontal oval
- placed slightly above center of the body
- glossy light blue gradient with white highlight on top-left

Linework:
- thick, uniform black outline
- smooth and clean, no sketchiness

Color:
- soft warm yellow (slightly desaturated)
- subtle shading on lower body and edges
- no texture, no noise

Style:
- flat cel-shaded cartoon
- clean vector-like finish
- similar to mobile game character design

Background:
- pure white

Avoid:
- realistic rendering
- 3D shading
- high detail textures
- lighting effects
- extra props or decorations. Keep this character as the main protagonist in every scene, with recognizable colors, silhouette, props, emotion, body language, and consistent appearance.



Image style prompt:

Use 2d flash animation style, simple outline art style, Among Us game style. Emphasize clear composition, readable subject placement, expressive lighting, detailed textures, cinematic camera language, and smooth continuity between shots.



Overall art style prompt:

Comedy story with a joy mood, cohesive color palette, consistent world design, high-detail cinematic frames, and Sora-friendly visual clarity.



Visual style: 2d flash animation style, simple outline art style, Among Us game style



Scene 1 - 0s:
Yellow sits at their desk, staring blankly at their computer screen.

Scene 2 - 3s:
A whoopee cushion suddenly appears under Yellow's desk, causing a slight rumble sound effect.

Scene 3 - 6s:
Yellow's eyes widen in surprise as they feel the whoopee cushion's vibrations through their chair, letting out a mock gasp of shock.

Scene 4 - 9s:
The whoopee cushion starts to inflate with air, making a comical "parp" sound effect, and Yellow can't help but burst into laughter.

Scene 5 - 12s:
Yellow jumps up from their chair, still chuckling, as the inflated whoopee cushion slides out from under the desk, revealing a trail of silly string in its wake.
